subject: Portal snapshot validation + SIG pulse
messages:
From: Sarah Whitaker <security@vendr.io>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com
Cc: portal-ops@vendr.io
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal snapshot request and SIG pulse

Hi Chloe,

We ran a sync for Redwood's profile this morning and noticed a small set of flagged answers in the SIG that changed since your last upload. Can you confirm whether you want us to: 

- pull a full portal snapshot (includes current QnA + attachments) for our records, or
- accept a delta manifest you upload (faster, smaller) and we’ll merge?

If you choose delta, please attach a CSV with filenames and SHA256 hashes. If full snapshot, we’ll schedule a short maintenance window to collect S3 manifests.

Quick note: the SIG shows a modified answer for control A.9.1 (privileged access). We flagged it for you to validate — not a blocker, but worth confirming.

Thanks,
Sarah Whitaker
Security Ops 
Vendr, Inc.
security@vendr.io

Attachment(s): none in initial message

From: chloe.martin@redwood.com <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Whitaker <security@vendr.io>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, portal-ops@vendr.io
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal snapshot request and SIG pulse

Sarah — thanks for the heads up. We prefer to provide a delta manifest for this run to avoid the full snapshot. I’m attaching a CSV with the files we expect you to reconcile.

Action items for Vendr:
- Accept the attached sig-delta-manifest.csv and run the merge.
- Leave the privileged-access answer in a "pending validation" state until we confirm (see internal note).
- Reply with the ingest ticket/ID so we can track.

Internal note: Marcus / Ben, I’ve cc’d you to confirm the manifest and the updated A.9.1 text. Marcus — can you verify the wording and whether this needs a new artifact? If so, please add to s3 evidence index and let Vendr know the key.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com

Attachment(s): sig-delta-manifest.csv (stub, CSV listing files + SHA256)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 12:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal snapshot request and SIG pulse

Chloe / Ben — I reviewed the flagged control (A.9.1). The answer change came from our recent privileged-access review; we tightened role names and added a short paragraph about break-glass procedures. Ben, I left the supporting doc in the evidence bucket under s3://redwood-evidence/controls/A9/2028-03-17-breakglass.pdf.

Notes: 
- I will export a small JSON manifest for the new breakglass doc and update the s3-evidence-index.json.
- For the SIG text, proposed wording below (short):
  "Privileged accounts are governed by RBAC with documented break-glass procedures and quarterly access reviews; break-glass actions are logged to a tamper-evident audit stream."

If that looks good I’ll attach the s3 index and the JSON manifest to the delta. Ben, can you confirm any retention/PNDA tags before I handoff?

—Marcus
Senior Security Engineer
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: chloe.martin@redwood.com <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Whitaker <security@vendr.io>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, portal-ops@vendr.io
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal snapshot request and SIG pulse

Sarah — attaching the delta bundle for ingestion.

What’s attached (stubs included here):
- sig-delta-manifest.csv — CSV with three entries (A.9.1-breakglass.pdf, auth-roles-v2.pdf, s3-evidence-index.json) and SHA256s.
- s3-evidence-index.json — index pointing to s3://redwood-evidence/controls/A9/A.9.1-breakglass.pdf (public stub).

Proposed SIG wording (confirmed by Marcus):
"Privileged accounts are governed by RBAC with documented break-glass procedures and quarterly access reviews; break-glass actions are logged to a tamper-evident audit stream."

Please ingest the delta and leave control A.9.1 in pending state until the ingest ticket is created. Reply with the Vendr ingest ticket ID and approximate propagation ETA so we can update OneTrust and our internal control tracker (REDWOOD-SEC-4721).

Thanks for coordinating — let me know if you need anything else.

Chloe Martin
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com

Attachment(s): sig-delta-manifest.csv, s3-evidence-index.json
References: https://vendor.vendr.io/portal/redwood-snapshot/2028-03-19 (portal view), https://onetrust.example.com/sig/qna/REDWOOD-4721
